==========================================================
HOW TO ADD A NEWS ITEM
Create a new file in news/ named YYYY-MM-DD-short-slug.qmd:

---
title: "Hayat successfully defends his master's thesis"
date: 2026-06-20
categories: [graduation]
description: "One-line summary shown in the listing (optional)."
image: ../assets/img/news/hayat-defense.jpg   # optional
---

Longer text of the news item here (optional). It becomes the
item's own page. An image dropped in assets/img/news/ can be
referenced in the front matter or the body.

The filename must start with the date (20...) so the listing
picks it up. Nothing else to configure.

Common categories: new members, graduation, conference,
publication, award, lab life.
==========================================================
